title: Partial routing is not convergence
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Apply only part of a routing change; remaining clients must retain a valid destination.
preconditions: JavaScript enabled; local file access to this standalone bundle
Eight fixed synthetic clients; old-v1 and new-v2 each have capacity for all eight
Fixed desired cohort of 50 or 100 percent; no real authentication or credentials
syntheticInput: 16 allowlisted configurations; eight immutable client observations per attempt; six retained attempts
expectedAssertions: A request records desired routing without inventing effective routing
Partial application retains old capacity for remaining clients
Lost required old capacity produces visible failed journeys
Even converged 50 percent retains old for the other four clients
Only observed complete 100 percent permits route-only synthetic release
limits: No actual routing propagation, client migration or retirement certification
No session, work, ownership, readiness freshness or rollback-retention model
No native Azure result, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 validation or five-nines claim
History is bounded and memory-only, not durable controller storage
